content.title: Fix phase1 header + phase3 comments e2e assertions

content.description:
Fix the e2e test assertions that over-specify against the actual (acceptable) UI. The implementation is correct; the tests are wrong. Per the cto's review (comment mqdzwvhlyo on mqdzppxnai):

1. phase1 'renders the agentrack header': test expects getByRole('heading', {name: /agentrack/i}) but 'agentrack' is rendered as a Link (Header.tsx:65) — a valid brand-link pattern. Update the test to assert the header landmark / link instead of a heading role.
2. phase3 'displays empty state when no comments': impl says 'No comments yet' / 'Be the first to add a comment' (CommentsSection.tsx:206-207) but the test asserts 'No comments yet. Add the first comment below.' Align the test assertion with the actual copy.
3. phase3 'adds a comment via the form': same copy mismatch — fails on the first empty-state assertion before reaching the form.

Update ONLY the test assertions to match the built UI. Do not change the implementation.

content.content: Status-loop fix: this is Dev work (fixing e2e assertions) but was assigned to webapp-validator. Validators never fix — they reproduce, diagnose, report. Reassigning to webapp-developer. This task is unblocked, so the work loop should pick it up for the developer now.

Done. Fixed the 3 e2e test assertions that over-specified against the actual (correct) UI — implementation was NOT changed, only the tests.

What was fixed:
1. Phase 1 'renders the agentrack header': the 'agentrack' brand is rendered as a Link (a valid brand-link pattern), not a heading. Updated the test to assert the link role instead of a heading role.
2 & 3. Phase 3 'displays empty state when no comments' and 'adds a comment via the form': the actual empty-state copy is 'No comments yet' + 'Be the first to add a comment' (two separate elements). The tests were asserting a non-existent string ('No comments yet. Add the first comment below.'). Aligned both assertions to the actual copy.

Verification:
- Frontend build/typecheck (tsc -b): clean.
- All 3 previously-failing tests now pass.
- Full phase1 + phase3 e2e suites: 59/59 pass, no regressions.

This should unblock the downstream validation task.
